q.q: In a row of 34 persons, Hina stands 17th from the left end and Sadia stands 28th from the right end. How many persons stand between them?
q.e: Sadia is 7th from the left (34 + 1 − 28); persons between = |7 − 17| − 1 = 9.

q.q: 5 students Ali, Danish, Imran, Sara, Waqar each have a test on a different day, from Monday to Friday (one test per day). Waqar's and Ali's tests are on consecutive days. Danish's test is neither on the first nor on the last day. Waqar's test is held on a day between those of Danish and Imran. Danish's test is held earlier in the week than Ali's. Imran's and Waqar's tests are on consecutive days. On which day is Imran's test held?
q.e: Place the definite clues first (immediate neighbours, ends), then use the 'between' and 'left of' clues to fix the rest; the arrangement is unique.

q.q: A man walks 15 m towards the west. He turns right. Then he walks 15 m. He turns right. Then he walks 6 m. He turns left. Then he walks 6 m. He turns right. Then he walks 16 m. He turns left. Then he walks 3 m. How far is he from the starting point, and in which direction (from the starting point) is he now?
q.e: Net displacement is 7 m east and 24 m north; distance = √(7² + 24²) = 25 m.

q.q: 5 students Bilal, Danish, Faraz, Mariam, Sara each have a test on a different day, from Monday to Friday (one test per day). Mariam's test is held earlier in the week than Faraz's. Sara's test is held on a day between those of Mariam and Faraz. Mariam's test is held on the day immediately before Danish's. Bilal's test is neither on the first nor on the last day. Bilal's and Faraz's tests are not on consecutive days. On which day is Sara's test held?
q.e: Place the definite clues first (immediate neighbours, ends), then use the 'between' and 'left of' clues to fix the rest; the arrangement is unique.
